about.description:
libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler.so is the MLIR/VPUX compiler that the Intel NPU
userspace driver (libze_intel_npu.so, package intel-level-zero-npu) loads,
through libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler_loader.so, to lower OpenVINO IR to NPU
blobs (the "Compiler-in-Driver" path). Built the way Intel builds the CiD:
npu_compiler as an OpenVINO extra module against a static OpenVINO
2026.4.1 build, with OpenVINO core, the IR frontend and Intel's
LLVM/MLIR fork statically linked into the two libraries. Co-install with
openvino + intel-level-zero-npu (+ NPU firmware system-wide) to run OpenVINO
inference on Intel NPU.

name: intel-driver-compiler-npu
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

# This recipe builds its own private, static copy of OpenVINO (and Intel's
# LLVM fork) into libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler.so. It has no dependency on
# conda-forge's OpenVINO packages and works with openvino-feedstock as it is
# today, at the cost of a much longer build.
#
# The preferred approach is conda-forge/staged-recipes#33473, which links
# against conda-forge's shared OpenVINO libraries instead of bundling a copy.
# It needs openvino-feedstock to first export the internal pieces the
# compiler uses (conda-forge/openvino-feedstock#164 and #178, a new
# libopenvino-npu-compiler-support output), so it requires review from the
# OpenVINO feedstock maintainers. The last maintainer update on this subject
# was on 2026-05-28 (conda-forge/openvino-feedstock#162), when it was passed
# on to Intel's NPU team. We understand their time is limited and are grateful
# for their work on OpenVINO; this vendored recipe lets users get NPU support
# in the meantime, and can be retired in favour of #33473 once that approach
# is accepted.

context:
  version: "2026.4.1"
  npu_compiler_rev: "0b38f7d42113ff329ac2bdd33583d123de4ccf2f"
  openvino_rev: "e213a14725769a6a2bf86fc86650aa78a9c05d3e"
  llvm_fork_rev: "8f3977c01be0f24be98b67ef2c911fd82657f30c"
  npu_elf_rev: "d325f45f2cb405b5fa2ff17a30de9469f1641b73"
  vpucostmodel_rev: "4b5da8484d7a5c8cb097486c1248c4d2a753ae4b"

package:
  name: intel-driver-compiler-npu
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/npu_compiler/archive/${{ npu_compiler_rev }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 195343e1d1973dea584fafdbaf7b5ab5092672f4413735b59ff8e8e731236d55
    target_directory: npu_compiler
    patches:
      - patches/0004-npu_compiler-undef-glibc-major-minor-macros.patch
      - patches/0007-npu_compiler-fallback-commit-hash-for-archive-source.patch
      - patches/0008-npu_compiler-gate-vpux-driver-compiler-tests.patch
      - patches/0012-npu_compiler-use-system-flatbuffers-from-openvino.patch
      - patches/0013-npu_compiler-gcc-false-positive-werror-nonfatal.patch
      - patches/0014-npu_compiler-xml-deserializer-weights-provider-api.patch
      - patches/0016-npu_compiler-unity-build-vpux-compiler.patch
      - patches/0017-npu_compiler-add-missing-include-guards.patch
      - patches/0018-npu_compiler-link-only-used-mlir-conversions.patch
  - url: https://github.com/intel-staging/npu-compiler-llvm/archive/${{ llvm_fork_rev }}.tar.gz
    sha256: aa38bd999ab706854745a7e969b0417f529cde0101290bc5be569fa8de4c2ad8
    target_directory: npu_compiler/thirdparty/llvm-project
  - url: https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/npu_compiler_elf/archive/${{ npu_elf_rev }}.tar.gz
    sha256: c3da6c465b4533a0cc2ca98eaddf91caf0beeb4ac8a561caff21972781e23608
    target_directory: npu_compiler/thirdparty/elf
  - url: https://github.com/intel/npu-nn-cost-model/archive/${{ vpucostmodel_rev }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 2dbe5085bb22e4bf374e87484871e53db0102af36b5b0d5ab2d81d064aa585c9
    target_directory: npu_compiler/thirdparty/vpucostmodel
    patches:
      - patches/0015-vpucostmodel-drop-werror.patch
  - url: https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 1ee85264556025486a4745a2d452ea823c578b3d162768bfef590366d2e6c539
    target_directory: openvino

build:
  number: 0
  skip: not linux64
  script:
    file: build.sh
    env:
      NPU_COMPILER_COMMIT_HASH: ${{ npu_compiler_rev }}
      OPENVINO_COMMIT_HASH: ${{ openvino_rev }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - lld
    - python 3.14.*
    - pkg-config
    - flatbuffers
    - git
  host:
    - tbb-devel
    - pugixml
    - xbyak 7.23.1.*
    - zlib
    - nlohmann_json
    - flatbuffers
    - level-zero-devel
  run_constraints:
    - libopenvino ${{ version }}.*
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('intel-driver-compiler-npu', upper_bound='x.x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    # header-only use; neither library is linked
    by_name:
      - flatbuffers
      - level-zero

tests:
  - script:
      - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler_loader.so
      - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler.so
      - test -z "$(ldd -r $PREFIX/lib/libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler.so 2>&1 | grep -E 'undefined symbol|not found')"
      - test -z "$(ldd -r $PREFIX/lib/libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler_loader.so 2>&1 | grep -E 'undefined symbol|not found')"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/npu_compiler
  summary: Intel NPU driver compiler (Compiler-in-Driver)
  description: |
    libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler.so is the MLIR/VPUX compiler that the Intel NPU
    userspace driver (libze_intel_npu.so, package intel-level-zero-npu) loads,
    through libopenvino_intel_npu_compiler_loader.so, to lower OpenVINO IR to NPU
    blobs (the "Compiler-in-Driver" path). Built the way Intel builds the CiD:
    npu_compiler as an OpenVINO extra module against a static OpenVINO
    ${{ version }} build, with OpenVINO core, the IR frontend and Intel's
    LLVM/MLIR fork statically linked into the two libraries. Co-install with
    openvino + intel-level-zero-npu (+ NPU firmware system-wide) to run OpenVINO
    inference on Intel NPU.
  license: Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
  license_file:
    - npu_compiler/LICENSE
    - npu_compiler/thirdparty/llvm-project/llvm/LICENSE.TXT
    - npu_compiler/thirdparty/elf/LICENCE
    - npu_compiler/thirdparty/vpucostmodel/LICENSE
    - openvino/LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hmaarrfk
